# camelCase words the Claude Code release watch never reports as drift.
# One word per line; what follows '#' is the reason. An entry belongs here only when the
# word can never be a key a user writes in a configuration file - a payload field the
# harness sends, a protocol field a server sends, a language built-in. A key that is
# merely out of scope (an IDE setting, a keybinding action) stays reported: scope is
# a judgement to make on the issue, not a filter to hide.

agentId                      # field of hook and status-line payloads, written by the harness
agentType                    # field of hook and status-line payloads, written by the harness
toString                     # JavaScript Object built-in, cited when a name collides with it
valueOf                      # JavaScript Object built-in, same reason
hasOwnProperty               # JavaScript Object built-in, same reason
uXXXX                        # notation of a JSON unicode escape, not a name
resultType                   # MCP protocol field returned by a server, not configuration
ttlMs                        # MCP protocol field returned by a server, not configuration
cacheScope                   # MCP protocol field returned by a server, not configuration
listChanged                  # MCP capability a server declares, not configuration
modelTimeoutException        # error type returned by a cloud provider, not configuration
serviceUnavailableException  # error type returned by a cloud provider, not configuration
setMcpServers                # Agent SDK method called from code (changelog 2.1.305), not a key of a file
setModel                     # Agent SDK method called from code (changelog 2.1.307), not a key of a file
isReadOnly                   # field of a mod's tool.check event, set by the harness (changelog 2.1.304), not configuration
